scripts.text:
[Cenia]
Welcome to the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[塞妮娅]
欢迎来到魔物博物馆。

scripts.text: Monster Museum?
scripts.translation: 魔物博物馆

scripts.text: Tips
scripts.translation: 提示

scripts.text:
[Cenia]
The Monster Museum was founded by
the Sages of the Schweicherbil
Magic Academy after researching
every creature dwelling in the
Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[塞妮娅]
魔物博物馆是由施瓦茨比尔魔法学院的贤者们，在对米德加尔特大陆上栖息的所有生物进行研究后创立的。

scripts.text:
[Cenia]
In this museum, you can see every
single monster in Midgard,
even the ones you hardly ever encounter.
scripts.translation:
[塞妮娅]
在这里，您可以看到米德加尔特所有的魔物，甚至包括那些您几乎从未遇到过的种类。

scripts.text:
[Cenia]
The glass tubes holding monsters
was developed with the latest
technology as a part of the
Schwarz Project. Rest assured,
you'll be well protected.
scripts.translation:
[塞妮娅]
用于容纳魔物的生化试管，是作为“施瓦茨计划”的一部分，利用最新技术开发的。请放心，您会得到很好的保护。

scripts.text:
[Cenia]
Please check on the Opaque option
on your option windows by
pressing ALT + O, if you want to
see the monsters better.
scripts.translation:
[塞妮娅]
如果您想更清楚地观察魔物，请按ALT+O打开选项窗口，并勾选“不透明”选项。

scripts.text:
[Cenia]
Feel free to talk to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[塞妮娅]
随时欢迎您来找我交谈。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Deviace
Size : Medium
Attribute : Water
scripts.translation:
学名：狄奥斯
体型：中型
属性：水

scripts.text:
Explanation :
This monster dwells under the deep
sea and has a round body with a
acetabulum on its dorsal side.
Although its sharp teeth are
intimidating, it has a very mellow
character.
scripts.translation:
说明：
这种魔物栖息在深海之中，拥有圆形的身体，背部有一个吸盘。虽然它锋利的牙齿看起来很吓人，但它的性格其实非常温和。

scripts.text:
Therefore, it never initiates
attack on an undersea traveler
unless it's attacked first.
However, once it becomes upset, it
uses high level magic skills. So
it's better to be careful with this monster.
scripts.translation: 因此，除非先被攻击，否则它绝不会主动袭击海底的旅行者。然而，一旦它变得愤怒，就会使用高级魔法技能。所以，遇到这种魔物时最好多加小心。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Seal
Size : Medium
Attribute : Water
scripts.translation:
学名：海豹宝宝
体型：中型
属性：水

scripts.text:
Explanation :
When you take a look at this
monster carefully, you will find
that it's not actually a seal but
an unidentified monster hiding
inside the seal-like leather
clothing.
scripts.translation:
说明：
如果您仔细观察这种魔物，就会发现它其实并不是海豹，而是一只躲在类似海豹皮毛服装里的未知魔物。

scripts.text:
It is rumored that the monster
wears this clothing in order
to protect its sensitive skin
from the weather. The Seal's
clothing is a very good material
for people to produce winter coats.
scripts.translation: 据说，这只魔物穿上这件衣服是为了保护它娇嫩的皮肤免受天气影响。海豹宝宝的皮毛是制作冬季外套的优质材料。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Sage Worm
Size : Small
Attribute : Neutral
scripts.translation:
学名：贤者虫
体型：小型
属性：中立

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A strange beast with the head of
an old scholar and the tail of a
worm. Although it is physically
weak, it has the intelligence
to support its comrades with
magic skills.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种长着老学者头部和虫子尾巴的奇异生物。虽然它身体虚弱，但拥有足够的智慧，能够使用魔法技能支援同伴。

scripts.text:
As its scholarly appearance
indicates, it's usually seen near books or book shelves.
scripts.translation: 正如它博学的外貌所示，它通常出现在书籍或书架附近。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Penomena
Size : Medium
Attribute : Poison
scripts.translation:
学名：梅纳海葵
体型：中型
属性：毒

scripts.text:
Explanation :
This monster dwells inside the
deepest part of caves where there
is enough moisture to keep it from
getting dried up.
scripts.translation:
说明：
这种魔物栖息在洞穴最深处，那里有足够的水分，能防止它干枯。

scripts.text:
Unlike Hydra, a similar looking
creature, it can move itself
towards its enemy using many
small appendixes on its acetabulum.
scripts.translation: 与外观相似的海葵不同，它可以通过吸盘上许多细小的附肢，主动移动身体去攻击敌人。

scripts.text:
The long, thin tentacles on the
body shoot deadly poison which is
enough to kill its enemy at once.
scripts.translation: 它身上细长触手射出的致命猛毒，足以瞬间杀死敌人。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Galapago
Size : Small
Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：啤酒企鹅
体型：小型
属性：土

scripts.text:
Explanation :
It's a kind of bird, but sadly, its body is too heavy to fly.
It's very sensitive to sunlight so it carries a water bottle and wears sunglasses all the time.
scripts.translation:
说明：
这是一种鸟类，但遗憾的是，它的身体太重，无法飞行。
它对阳光非常敏感，所以总是随身携带水瓶并戴着太阳眼镜。

scripts.text:
Although gluttonous, it will
always cooperate to attack
prey, as well as predators.
Otherwise, Galapago is a
generally laid back monster.
scripts.translation:
虽然它很贪吃，但为了捕猎，它会与猎物甚至捕食者合作。
除此之外，啤酒企鹅通常是一种性格随和的魔物。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Raydric
Size : Large
Attribute : Shadow
scripts.translation:
学名：幽灵剑士
体型：大型
属性：暗

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A suit of armor animated by the
spirit of a castle guard. The
spirit is bound to this armor by
a powerful curse.
scripts.translation:
说明：
由城堡卫兵的精灵附身而动的盔甲。
这具盔甲被强大的诅咒束缚着。

scripts.text:
Since Raydric used to be a castle
guard, it possesses fast movements
and powerful attack strength.
scripts.translation: 由于幽灵剑士生前是城堡卫兵，它拥有敏捷的动作和强大的攻击力。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Chepet
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Fire
scripts.translation:
学名：魔灵娃娃
体型：中型
属性：火

scripts.text:
Explanation :
An evil creature hiding in a
pretty doll. It attacks passersby
by striking matchsticks held in
the doll's hand. A very rare
monster since it dwells in
only a few places.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种藏在漂亮玩偶里的邪恶生物。它通过击打玩偶手中的火柴来攻击路人。
由于它只栖息在少数几个地方，因此非常稀有。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Violy
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Neutral
scripts.translation:
学名：薇欧莉
体型：中型
属性：中立

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A pretty doll looking creature with beautiful golden hair.
Since It plays violin all the time with a peaceful look on its face, people don't realize at first that it's a monster.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种长着金色头发、外表漂亮的玩偶生物。
它总是面带祥和的表情拉着小提琴，因此人们起初往往意识不到它是一只魔物。

scripts.text: Exercise extreme caution upon encountering a Violy. Otherwise, it will snatch your soul in no time with its charming song.
scripts.translation: 遇到薇欧莉时务必极度小心。否则，它会用迷人的歌声瞬间夺走你的灵魂。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Alice 
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Neutral
scripts.translation:
学名：爱丽丝
体型：中型
属性：中立

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Alice is a robot made to assist as
a castle housemaid. They've been
known to remain and automatically
do their tasks long after the
castle has been abandoned.
scripts.translation:
说明：
爱丽丝是作为城堡女仆而制造的机器人。即使城堡被废弃，它们也常会留下来自动执行任务。

scripts.text:
Without any discernable power
source, how it moves and operates
is still a scientific mystery.
scripts.translation: 在没有可辨识的动力源的情况下，它的运作原理至今仍是一个科学谜团。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Assulter
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Wind
scripts.translation:
学名：阿苏尔特
体型：中型
属性：风

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Unlike other turtles on Turtle
Island, this turtle stands on two
legs and attacks passersby with
the other two legs, wielding a
big shuriken from its back.
scripts.translation:
说明：
与龟岛上的其他乌龟不同，这种乌龟用两条腿站立，并用另外两条腿攻击路人，同时挥舞着背上的大飞镖。

scripts.text:
Interestingly, it creates a clone
to do more damage when it
encounters dangerous enemies.
It does very powerful damage using
its shuriken, but its nail attack
is more threatening.
scripts.translation:
有趣的是，当遇到危险的敌人时，它会制造一个分身来造成更多伤害。
它使用飞镖造成的伤害非常强大，但其爪击更具威胁性。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Wanderer
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Wind
scripts.translation:
学名：浪姬舞者
体型：中型
属性：风

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Undead warrior who came back to
life through a curse. Considering
its technical fencing skill, he
must have been a very honorable
warrior as a living human.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一位因诅咒而复活的亡灵战士。考虑到其精湛的剑术，他生前必定是一位非常高贵的战士。

scripts.text:
Wanderer can move amazingly fast
and can slay enemies with a single
stroke of its sword.
scripts.translation: 浪姬舞者的移动速度极快，能够一剑斩杀敌人。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Caterpillar
 Size : Small
 Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：狂暴绿棉虫
体型：小型
属性：地

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Although the eyes of this creature
have atrophied due to living under
the earth, it uses a feeler and
appendices on its body to sense
objects in its dark surroundings.
scripts.translation:
说明：
虽然这种生物因为生活在地下，眼睛已经退化，但它利用触角和身体上的附属器官来感知黑暗环境中的物体。

scripts.text:
Caterpillar is rumored to be the
larva of Creamy Fear, the advanced
Creamy.
scripts.translation: 据传，狂暴绿棉虫是狂暴克瑞米（克瑞米的进化形态）的幼虫。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Thief Bug
 ^FFFFFFScientific name :^000000 (Male)
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Shadow
scripts.translation:
学名：浮勒盗虫
^FFFFFF学名：^000000（雄性）
体型：中型
属性：暗

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Although it has a big blue body,
it's also fast and voracious, just like other Thief Bugs.
scripts.translation:
说明：
虽然它有着巨大的蓝色身体，但和其他浮勒盗虫一样，它既敏捷又贪婪。

scripts.text: However, it is stronger than other Thief Bugs because it's designated to protect the females and babies from danger.
scripts.translation: 不过，它比其他浮勒盗虫更强壮，因为它被指派负责保护雌性和幼崽免受危险。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Tri Joint
 Size : Small
 Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：三叶虫
体型：小型
属性：地

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Tri Joint is a prehistoric
monster that is covered with
a hard shell, and uses a feeler
instead of eyes so that it can
live in dark places.
scripts.translation:
说明：
三叶虫是一种史前魔物，全身覆盖着坚硬的外壳，并用触角代替眼睛，以便在黑暗的地方生存。

scripts.text: Recently, since many Tri Joints have been discovered inside many caves, Sages are very excited to study them to learn more about the evolution of monsters in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 最近，由于在许多洞穴中发现了大量三叶虫，贤者们非常兴奋，希望研究它们以了解米德加尔特魔物的进化。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Arclouz
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：阿克鲁兹
体型：中型
属性：地

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Hard shelled monster that coils
its body to attack its enemy.
Arclouz tend to stay in groups
and are very aggressive
creatures.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种硬壳魔物，通过卷曲身体来攻击敌人。
阿克鲁兹倾向于群居，是非常具有攻击性的生物。

scripts.text:
They have incredibly fast
movement speed, contrary to
their looks, and are often
compared to PecoPecos.
scripts.translation: 尽管外表笨重，它们的移动速度却快得惊人，因此常被拿来与大嘴鸟作比较。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Dragon Tail
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Wind
scripts.translation:
学名：刺尾蜻蜓
体型：中型
属性：风

scripts.text:
Explanation :
An insect which is considered as
a Libelluidae, or Dragon Fly. It
uses its strong tail to suck the
blood out of an enemy, or to put
the enemy to sleep by shooting
a sleeping poison.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种被视为蜻蜓目（龙蝇）的昆虫。它利用强壮的尾巴吸取敌人的血液，或者通过喷射催眠毒素使敌人陷入沉睡。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Owl Duke
 Size : Large
 Attribute : Neutral
scripts.translation:
学名：鹗枭首领
体型：大型
属性：中立

scripts.text:
Explanation:
An owl that wears a count costume.
It's very intimidating looking
with its dark, yet suave look.
Owl Duke is not actually an owl,
but a devil with very sharp claws
on its big feet.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一只穿着伯爵服装的猫头鹰。
它看起来非常令人畏惧，既阴暗又优雅。
鹗枭首领实际上并不是猫头鹰，而是一个拥有锋利巨爪的恶魔。

scripts.text:
It's skillful at using many
lightning magic spells. When
you see it attacking an enemy,
you can sense the Owl Duke's
aristocratic pompousness.
scripts.translation: 它擅长使用许多雷电魔法。当你看到它攻击敌人时，你能感受到鹗枭首领那种贵族般的傲慢。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Marine Sphere
 Size : Small
 Attribute : Water
scripts.translation:
学名：气泡虫
体型：小型
属性：水

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A strange creature that wanders
in the deep oceans. It explodes
with great power when it's
touched, earning it the name
'The Sea Bomb.'
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种在深海游荡的奇怪生物。当它被触碰时，会爆发出巨大的力量，因此得名“海炸弹”。

scripts.text:
If there is a Marine Sphere
caught in the explosion of
another, a trigger explosion
will result, and can lead to
a dangerous chain reaction.
scripts.translation: 如果一个气泡虫被另一个气泡虫的爆炸波及，就会引发连锁爆炸，并可能导致危险的连锁反应。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Mandragora
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：曼陀罗魔花
体型：中型
属性：土

scripts.text:
Explanation :
An insectivore that swallows
anything alive. When it finds
its prey, it strikes it first
with a long tentacle to
to paralyze it.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种食虫植物，会吞食任何活物。当它发现猎物时，会先用长长的触手将其麻痹。

scripts.text:
Once paralyzed, its prey is
put in a large tube attached
to its body where it is slowly
digested. Although this tube
has a skull mark, Mandragora
does not actually contain any
poison.
scripts.translation: 猎物被麻痹后，会被放入连接在其身上的巨大管道中慢慢消化。虽然这个管道上有一个骷髅标记，但曼陀罗魔花实际上并不含有任何毒素。

scripts.text:
This digestive tube
apparatus also has a very unique,
but disgusting smell that is far
from useful in attracting prey.
scripts.translation: 这种消化管道装置还散发着一股非常独特但令人作呕的气味，这完全无助于吸引猎物。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Geographer
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：邪恶向日葵
体型：中型
属性：土

scripts.text:
Explanation :
An insectivore that looks like
a sunflower. It uses the petal
like tentacles around its
mouth to attract and snare
its prey.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种看起来像向日葵的食虫植物。它利用嘴周围花瓣状的触手来吸引并捕捉猎物。

scripts.text:
Unlike Mandragora, Geographer
does not have a tube to
store its prey. So it slowly
eats it's prey, little by little.
scripts.translation: 与曼陀罗魔花不同，邪恶向日葵没有用来储存猎物的管道。因此，它会一点一点地慢慢吃掉猎物。

scripts.text:
Although Geographer has small
and short roots, the roots are
tough and strong enough to
bear the weight of the upper body.
scripts.translation: 虽然邪恶向日葵的根又小又短，但这些根非常坚韧有力，足以支撑上半身的重量。

scripts.text:
The namesake of this monster, a
human geographer that was
promptly eaten upon discovering
this species of beast, will
never be forgotten...
scripts.translation: 这种魔物的名字来源于一位人类地理学家，他在发现这种生物后立刻被吃掉了，他的名字将永不被遗忘...

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Rafflesia
 Size : Small
 Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：草精
体型：小型
属性：土

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A puffy, leafy monster
threatened with extinction.
Rafflesia is the rarest
monster in Midgard and
is thus protected by law.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种蓬松多叶的魔物，濒临灭绝。
草精是米德加尔特最稀有的魔物，因此受到法律保护。

scripts.text:
Due to this situation, most Sages
are having a hard time to
research this monster.
However, a few Sages are
currently seeking methods to
cultivate and save the Rafflesias.
scripts.translation:
由于这种情况，大多数贤者都很难研究这种魔物。
不过，目前仍有少数贤者正在寻找培育和拯救草精的方法。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Stem Worm
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Wind
scripts.translation:
学名：灰森灵
体型：中型
属性：风

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A mutated Worm Tail that has a
round, brownish grey body with
a small head. It is covered
with scales and has a long
stem-like tail which is used
as a whip in attacks.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种变异的尾虫，拥有圆滚滚的灰褐色身体和一个小头。它全身覆盖着鳞片，并有一条长长的茎状尾巴，在攻击时用作鞭子。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Blazzer
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Fire
scripts.translation:
学名：火焰妖
体型：中型
属性：火

scripts.text:
Explanation :
This is a fire ball that has been
seen near volcanic zones.
Because of this monster's sudden
appearance, Sages believe that
volcanic activity may occur
sooner or later near Juno.
scripts.translation:
说明：
这是一种在火山地带附近被观察到的火球。
由于这种魔物突然出现，贤者们认为朱诺附近迟早会发生火山活动。

scripts.text:
Blazzer blows out noxious gas
which harm passersby. It is
unknown whether or not these
are attacks or the Blazzer's
form of communication.
scripts.translation: 火焰妖会喷出有害的废气，伤害路人。尚不清楚这是它的攻击行为，还是火焰妖的一种交流方式。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Ride Word
 Size : Small
 Attribute : Neutral
scripts.translation:
学名：骑乘词
体型：小型
属性：中立

scripts.text:
Explanation :
It's a cursed magic book with
sharp teeth. It exists to attack any living thing nearby.
scripts.translation:
说明：
这是一本长着锋利牙齿的诅咒魔法书。它的存在就是为了攻击附近任何活物。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Megalodon
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Undead
scripts.translation:
学名：邪骸食人鱼
体型：中型
属性：不死

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A skeleton fish that was brought
back to life by a curse. Although
It looks very threatening, it's
benign and will not attack
undersea travellers outright.
scripts.translation:
说明：
这是一条被诅咒复活的骸骨鱼。虽然它看起来非常具有威胁性，但它性情温和，不会主动攻击水下的旅行者。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Sleeper
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Earth
scripts.translation:
学名：沙妖
体型：中型
属性：土

scripts.text:
Explanation :
Unidentified sand creature.
Usually it stays under the earth,
but when travellers step on the
sand, it may abruptly
appear to attack them.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一种未鉴定的沙地生物。
通常它潜伏在地面之下，但当旅行者踩到沙子时，它可能会突然现身并发起攻击。

scripts.text:
It's smaller than Sandman and can
cause indirect attacks by causing a sand storm.
scripts.translation: 它比泥人小，能通过引发沙尘暴进行间接攻击。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Ancient Mummy
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Undead
scripts.translation:
学名：狂暴木乃伊
体型：中型
属性：不死

scripts.text:
Explanation :
A mummy cursed with eternal life.
Although wrapped in decaying
bandages, Ancient Mummy also
wears a splendid hair ornament
adorned with a snake.
scripts.translation:
说明：
一个被诅咒而获得永生的木乃伊。
虽然它裹着腐烂的绷带，但狂暴木乃伊头上还戴着一个装饰着蛇的华丽头饰。

scripts.text:
This kind of head ornament
indicates that the Ancient
Mummy was a person of high rank
while he was still alive.
scripts.translation: 这种头饰表明，狂暴木乃伊生前是一位地位显赫的人物。

scripts.text:
Since Ancient Mummy has
been wandering the underworld
for a long time, it does not have
any consciousness and will
attack any living thing nearby.
scripts.translation: 由于狂暴木乃伊在冥界游荡了很长时间，它已经失去了意识，会攻击附近任何活物。

scripts.text:
Scientific name : Incubus
 Size : Medium
 Attribute : Shadow
scripts.translation:
学名：恶魔侍者
体型：中型
属性：暗影

scripts.text:
Explanation :
This demon attracts humans
with its stunningly beautiful
appearance. When it poses as a
male human, we call it Incubus.
As a female, we call it Succubus.
scripts.translation:
说明：
这种恶魔以其惊人的美貌吸引人类。当它伪装成男性时，我们称之为恶魔侍者；当它伪装成女性时，我们称之为梦魔。

scripts.text:
This devil targets people with
mental vulnerabilities so that
it can eventually take them to hell.
scripts.translation: 这种恶魔专门针对心理脆弱的人，以便最终将他们带入地狱。
